headline: Suraj Limited appoints new Company Secretary
hook: Leadership change in Suraj Limited compliance office
summary: Suraj Limited has officially appointed Mr. Mayank Balvantbhai Rami as its Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The appointment is effective from November 01, 2026. This role is responsible for ensuring the company adheres to regulatory and legal standards.
why_it_matters: Routine administrative change with no immediate impact on stock price.

headline: Suraj Limited declares financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
hook: September quarter financial results submitted to exchange
summary: Suraj Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance figures for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Investors can review the reported revenue, profit margins, and operational metrics through the exchange portal. Retail shareholders of Suraj Limited can assess these earnings to evaluate the company's recent operational health.
whats_next: Earnings conference call or shareholder disclosures if scheduled
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for Suraj Limited shareholders.
